messages:
mike_se: Quick sync: mapping POC user journeys + security clarifications with AcmeBank. Need to finalize top 3 endpoints and answer SSO/KMS/data-residency Qs by Fri. @jessica_sales @shalini_solutions

jessica_sales: Thanks — can we lock top 3 by EOD Wed? Sales needs those for SOW. Top candidates: account-summary, transaction-assist, fraud-alerts. Thoughts?

shalini_solutions: Agree those are high value. Suggest prioritizing transaction-assist (chat), account-summary (embeddings/search), and alerts (rerank). Each should have an acceptance test + sample prompts.

tom_engine: For acceptance tests, include latency SLOs: p95 < 400ms for single-turn chat on Hosted, and embed retrieval p95 < 120ms. Also add token-usage budget for each test.

renee_security: Security Qs from AcmeBank: SSO via SAML, BYOK/KMS key residency, audit logs retention 7y, and scoped API tokens. We need to be explicit in the RFP reply.

mike_se: Noted. For prompts/evals: we'll ship a small prompt suite per endpoint (~8-12 prompts). Example prompt for transaction-assist: "Show recent ACH debits > $500 and flag unusual vendor names." We'll include golden answers and a simple scoring rubric (precision on flagged items, summarization fidelity).

shalini_solutions: I'll draft journeys and sample prompts. Can someone sanity-check the endpoint contract? Here's a stub:

```
POST /api/v1/poc/transaction-assist
payload: { user_id, start_date, end_date, n_results, include_kv }
response: { messages: [...], actions: [...] }
```

jessica_sales: Also need to confirm which environment (Hosted vs Dedicated) for latency guarantees in SOW. AcmeBank asked about Private VPC option.

tom_engine: For POC, recommend Hosted + VPC peering initially unless they require on-prem. Dedicated will change pricing (~+30% monthly commit). I'll add a short pricing delta table.

renee_security: KMS: customer-managed keys supported in Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports envelope encryption with Redwood-managed KMS only. Call that out. Also clarify where audit logs land and retention options.

security-bot: Automated note: Security questionnaire Q4.2 updated: BYOK support = "Partial (Dedicated/Private)". See internal doc: https://redwood.red/docs/security/byok

mike_se: Action items:
1) shalini_solutions: share journeys + sample prompts by Tue
2) tom_engine: draft SLOs + pricing delta by Wed
3) renee_security: prepare security answer + minimal diagram by Thu
4) jessica_sales: update SOW template with selected endpoints.
Target: sign-off Fri COB. :thumbsup:

jessica_sales: Sounds good. I'll insert the three endpoints and include eval criteria (latency, throughput, quality thresholds).

shalini_solutions: Sharing initial prompt set now — I'll upload to the shared drive and include a tiny eval harness (manual labels + auto metrics).

tom_engine: Quick ops note: rate limits for POC — request quota bump to 200rps for burst window. Ops ticket needed ASAP. @ops (please ping).

renee_security: I'll draft the security appendix and include a data flow diagram showing SAML handshake, KMS boundaries, and log flow to SIEM.

mike_se: Great. If any blocker surfaces (legal, procurement), flag here. Otherwise I'll schedule a 30m call Thu 11am to review.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from jessica_sales, :eyes: from renee_security)
